label: Electrical
description: Dead outlets, switches, flickering lights or a tripping breaker.

required_shots.prompt: Show the outlet, switch or light
required_shots.tip: Fill the frame. Don't touch anything that's sparking or hot.
required_shots.hint: The outlet, switch, fixture or appliance cord with the problem, close enough to see the plate and any marks.

required_shots.prompt: Step back and show where it is
required_shots.tip: Include the wall or ceiling around it.
required_shots.hint: A wider view of the room showing where the fixture is.

required_shots.tip: Open the door so the switches are in view.
required_shots.hint: The electrical panel with breakers visible.

severity_guide: one cosmetic issue, e.g. a loose or cracked cover plate, everything works
one outlet, switch or light not working, no heat or marks
several fixtures out, or flickering in one room
a breaker that keeps tripping, or a whole room or circuit out
sparks, burning smell, scorch marks, heat or buzzing: a safety risk

policy.finding_wording: Electrical issue visible, on-site inspection by a licensed electrician recommended.
rules: Describe what is visible; say 'likely' for any cause.
Never tell the homeowner to open, repair or test wiring themselves.
affected_area_m2 is usually 0 for electrical jobs unless a surface is visibly damaged.
